remarks: Welcome to this luxurious unit which includes 2 spacious bedrooms and 2 full baths, with the primary bedroom boasting an en-suite bath and custom walk-in closet, offering 1,334 sq ft of open floor plan living, with 10-foot ceilings and an abundance of natural light streaming through the 8-foot wall of windows in the spacious living room. The kitchen, perfect for entertaining, features a large granite island and stainless steel appliances. Additional conveniences include in-unit laundry and a dedicated storage cage.  This apartment includes 2 parking spaces: one in a covered garage and one in a private lot. Residents can enjoy the building's full gym. Ideally located as is within walking distance to restaurants, the Maritime Aquarium, theaters, waterfront access, Oyster Shell Park, the Norwalk River Valley Trail, and shopping at the SONO Collection Mall. Additionally, it's a short walk to Metro North and offers convenient access to I-95, US-7, and US-1.
